title: Siṅgālaka (1)
text: 1 Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || 2 Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccusasamayaṃ siṅgālassa vassamānassāti || || Evam bhante || || 3 Eso kho bhikkhave jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇṇakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho || So yena yena icchati tena tena gacchati || yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha tiṭṭhati || yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha nisīdati || yattha yattha icchati attha tattha nippajjati [page 272] 272 OPAMMA-SAṂYUTTA [XX. 11. 4 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...]|| sītako pi naṃ vāto upavāyati || || 4 Sādhu khvassa bhikkhave yam idhekacco sakyaputtiyapatiñño evarūpaṃ pi attabhāvapatilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha || || 5 Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || || Appamattā viharissāmāti || || 6 Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Ekādasamaṃ || ||
